notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.notes: Fixed bug stopping players from building in empty chunk.

notes.title: Multiplayer Update
notes.notes: This patch has added multiplayer and new blocks. In order to play with your friends one person will have to host the server on their computer. Then, their friends will be able to join either through steam or with the IP address of the host. When you are hosting the server remember to port forward in order for people from outside your network to be able to join.
